sentences.en: Love has been described as an affection curable by marriage.
sentences.zh: 爱情曾被描述为一种婚姻可以治愈的情感。

sentences.en: Get a cat! Don't expect affection from other human beings!
sentences.zh: 养只猫吧！别指望从其他人那里得到关爱！

sentences.en: The baby transferred its affection to its new mother.
sentences.zh: 婴儿把它的喜爱转移到了新的母亲身上。

senses.zh: 感情；喜爱，关爱；爱慕之情；影响 形容词: affectional
